findings.claim: The rebuilt dist hooks import dist helper modules that are not added by this diff, so executing the registered hooks will fail with module resolution errors.
findings.evidence: New dist files import `./lib/hook-io.mjs` and `./lib/paths.mjs` (`.claude/hooks/dist/gofmt-check.mjs` lines 3 and 5; similarly guard-generated/license-header/session-context), but the diff only adds these helpers under `.claude/hooks/src/lib/` and does not add `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/hook-io.mjs` or `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/paths.mjs`, despite criterion 4.1 requiring rebuilt dist and working registered hooks.
findings.suggested_fix: Run the hook build so `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/hook-io.mjs` and `.claude/hooks/dist/lib/paths.mjs` are generated and committed, or remove dist artifacts and adjust registration to run built sources consistently.

findings.claim: The PreToolUse registration does not match the required matcher and timeout.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 4.1 requires `PreToolUse/PostToolUse matcher Edit|Write|MultiEdit, 10s timeout`; the PreToolUse registration uses `"matcher": "Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit"` and `"timeout": 5`.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the PreToolUse matcher to `Edit|Write|MultiEdit` and set the guard hook timeout to 10 seconds.

findings.claim: The license-header hook can silently accept Go files without the required WSO2 Apache header if any leading line merely contains the words `Apache License`.
findings.evidence: Constraint `license-header` requires every `.go` file to start with the WSO2 Apache 2.0 license header, but `hasLicenseHeader` returns true for any of the first 30 lines matching `/Apache License/`, not for the actual header at the top of the file.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate the expected header prefix, or at least require the canonical `Licensed under the Apache License`/`Apache License, Version 2.0` lines in the leading comment block before `package`.
